title: Protections for Platform Workers Affected by Food Delivery Platform Company's Exit from Singapore
what_it_is: Protections for Platform Workers Affected by Food Delivery Platform Company's Exit from Singapore

sections.label: Delivery riders platform exit help
sections.summary: This refers to a report on help for delivery riders affected by a food delivery platform company's exit.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: [Please refer to "Help for Delivery Riders Affected by Recent Exit of Food Delivery Platform Company", Official Report, 7 April 2026, Vol 96, Issue 27, to Written Answers to Questions for Oral Answer Not Answered by End of Question Time section.]

sections.label: NTUC platform worker support measures
sections.summary: This states NTUC led discussions on payment and incentive principles, and that operators, WSG, NTUC and unions offered job matching, coaching and assistance schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: This has been done before, especially on the transparency of earnings and so on.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: And to better guide these discussions, NTUC has led many of these discussions, for example, with platform work associations, major platform operators, to agree on a set of industry-wide and accepted principles, in terms of payment and incentive structures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Some of these things were discussed: for example, fair earnings, visibility on structural changes, incentive schemes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: These were announced on 11 September 2025 by NTUC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: On the second supplementary question, in this particular case, I want to share that the food delivery operator, had really worked closely with Workforce Singapore (WSG) and also NTUC's Employment and Employability Institute to step in to offer job matching capabilities and also career coaching in times of need.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: The platform operator also worked, like what Member has mentioned, with the Singapore Manual and Mercantile Workers' Union and the National Delivery Champions Association to facilitate their outreach and transition.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: The platform work associations, together with NTUC, should continue to help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: There are schemes out there, for example, if a platform worker would like to transition to full-time employment or to a different platform, they can always approach WSG with a suite of capabilities, SkillsFuture, as well as the Career Conversion Programmes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For low-wage platform workers, they can also approach the social services office to help with financial assistance.
